skills.name: source-analysis
skills.description: Decompose source prose or a script into events, entities, and a complete fact registry.

skills.name: adaptation
skills.description: Turn prose into comic story: separate source facts, user changes, and additions, then compress for the page.

skills.name: narrative-structure
skills.description: Map acts, turning points, setups and payoffs, and pacing across issues and pages.

skills.name: comic-scripting
skills.description: Write panel-by-panel script: one drawable moment per panel, exact dialogue, captions, and sound effects.

skills.name: text-humanization
skills.description: Write and rewrite prose so it reads like a person wrote it, removing the catalogued AI-writing tells.

skills.name: character-consistency
skills.description: Lock canonical character identity so every drawn appearance matches every other.

skills.name: character-sheet-generation
skills.description: Produce reference sheets (turnarounds, expressions, wardrobe) that become approved identity masters.

skills.name: location-design
skills.description: Define each location's architecture, dressing, light, and time-of-day states.

skills.name: location-mapping
skills.description: Map levels, sides, landmarks, and exits so panels can state positions precisely.

skills.name: visual-style-development
skills.description: Define the comic's visual language (line, tone, texture, rendering) as an enforceable style bible.

skills.name: color-scripting
skills.description: Plan palette, spot color, and tonal progression per scene and page.

skills.name: reference-ingestion
skills.description: Analyze user-supplied reference material and turn it into bible entries and registered reference assets.

skills.name: scene-blocking
skills.description: Stage each scene on the location map: positions, movement paths, eyelines, travel and threat directions.

skills.name: page-layout
skills.description: Design the page: panel count, grid, relative panel size, reading order, and page turns.

skills.name: panel-composition
skills.description: Choose framing, angle, and staging inside the panel so the moment and the actor are unmistakable.

skills.name: sequential-storytelling
skills.description: Order panels into readable sequences: transitions, gutter ellipses, and flow from panel to panel.

skills.name: thumbnailing
skills.description: Rough each page as thumbnails to test readability before any final generation.

skills.name: performance-direction
skills.description: Direct character acting as visible, drawable behavior instead of emotion labels.

skills.name: balloon-lettering
skills.description: Place balloons, captions, and sound effects in reading order with the exact approved text.

skills.name: state-tracking
skills.description: Keep the panel ledger: position, custody, wardrobe, and physical state for every character and object.

skills.name: reference-selection
skills.description: Choose which approved reference images each page needs, and give each one a single role.

skills.name: production-orchestration
skills.description: Run the pipeline: phase gates, approval workflow, dependency order, and batch cost confirmation.

skills.name: self-evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate a fresh artifact cold against schema, rules, and the producing skill's quality bar; apply clear fixes.

skills.name: prompt-compilation
skills.description: Compile provider-ready prompt packages from bibles, page files, and reference plans; never freehand.

skills.name: image-generation
skills.description: Generate pages and reference art through image providers with dry-run, provenance, and cost discipline.

skills.name: page-repair
skills.description: Repair a failed page with a targeted sibling version, locked elements, and a two-cycle limit.

skills.name: pixel-review
skills.description: Inspect the rendered pixels against plan and references and record evidence-based findings.

skills.name: continuity-checking
skills.description: Audit position, custody, state, wardrobe, and geography across panels, pages, and issues.

skills.name: edition-assembly
skills.description: Select reviewed page versions, assemble an edition, and export it without overwriting earlier ones.
